description.zh-CN: 广泛性焦虑量表（GAD-7），国际上广泛使用的焦虑症状筛查量表，询问过去两周内 7 种常见焦虑症状出现的频率。
description.en: The Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7, a widely used screener that asks how often seven common anxiety symptoms occurred over the last two weeks.

instructions.zh-CN: 在过去的两周里，你有多少时间受到以下问题的困扰？
instructions.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

licenseNote.zh-CN: GAD-7 由 Robert L. Spitzer、Kurt Kroenke、Janet B.W. Williams、Bernd Löwe 等人在 Pfizer 教育资助下编制，属于公有领域，复制、翻译、展示和分发均无需许可（见 phqscreeners.com 使用手册）。
licenseNote.en: The GAD-7 was developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Kurt Kroenke, Janet B.W. Williams, Bernd Löwe and colleagues with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc. It is in the public domain; no permission is required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute (PHQ instruction manual, phqscreeners.com).

source.zh-CN: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. A brief measure for assessing generalized anxiety disorder: the GAD-7. Arch Intern Med 2006;166:1092-1097。分级依据官方使用手册。中文措辞采用国内研究中广泛使用的简体中文版本，尚未与官方中文译本逐字核对。
source.en: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. A brief measure for assessing generalized anxiety disorder: the GAD-7. Arch Intern Med 2006;166:1092-1097. Severity bands follow the official instruction manual.

citation: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JBW, Löwe B. A brief measure for assessing generalized anxiety disorder: the GAD-7. Arch Intern Med. 2006;166(10):1092-1097.

text.en: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge

text.zh-CN: 不能够停止或控制担忧
text.en: Not being able to stop or control worrying

text.zh-CN: 对各种各样的事情担忧过多
text.en: Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still

text.zh-CN: 感到似乎将有可怕的事情发生而害怕
text.en: Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

summary.zh-CN: 过去两周里，焦虑相关的症状很少或几乎没有。
summary.en: Few or no anxiety symptoms over the last two weeks.

suggestions.zh-CN: 继续保持让你感到放松和稳定的习惯。
suggestions.en: Keep the habits that help you feel calm and steady.

suggestions.zh-CN: 状态有变化时，可以过一段时间再做一次自评作比较。
suggestions.en: If things change, take this check-in again later to compare.

summary.zh-CN: 存在一些焦虑相关的症状，程度较轻。面对压力时出现担忧和紧张是很常见的反应。
summary.en: Some anxiety symptoms at a mild level — worry and tension are common responses to stress.

suggestions.zh-CN: 试试放慢呼吸、散步或伸展等简单的放松方法。
suggestions.en: Try simple ways to unwind, such as slow breathing, a walk or stretching.

suggestions.zh-CN: 把担心的事写下来，区分哪些可以行动、哪些暂时无法控制。
suggestions.en: Write worries down and separate what you can act on from what you cannot control right now.

suggestions.zh-CN: 减少咖啡因和睡前使用手机的时间，可能有助于放松。
suggestions.en: Cutting down on caffeine and screens before bed may help.

summary.zh-CN: 焦虑相关的症状已经比较明显。官方手册建议把 10 分作为需要进一步评估的参考线。
summary.en: Anxiety symptoms are fairly noticeable. The official manual recommends 10 or more as the point for further evaluation.

suggestions.zh-CN: 建议和医生、心理咨询师或其他专业人士聊一聊，获得进一步的评估。
suggestions.en: Consider talking with a doctor, counsellor or other professional for a proper assessment.

suggestions.zh-CN: 把感受告诉一位信任的人。
suggestions.en: Share how you feel with someone you trust.

suggestions.zh-CN: 规律的睡眠和适度运动对缓解紧张有帮助。
suggestions.en: Regular sleep and moderate exercise can ease tension.

summary.zh-CN: 焦虑相关的症状较多且频繁，可能已经明显影响到生活。你值得得到专业的支持。
summary.en: Many frequent anxiety symptoms that may be clearly affecting daily life. You deserve professional support.

suggestions.zh-CN: 建议尽快联系医院的精神心理科、心理门诊或专业咨询机构。
suggestions.en: Please contact a mental-health service, clinic or qualified professional soon.

suggestions.zh-CN: 需要倾诉时，可以拨打全国统一心理援助热线 12356。
suggestions.en: If you need someone to talk to, call a mental-health helpline (in China: 12356).

suggestions.zh-CN: 请告诉身边信任的人你最近的状态。
suggestions.en: Let someone close to you know how you have been.
